name: pictures-in-a-row
about: Three pictures asked on three frames in a row, the window closed on the next: each is copied while the one before is still in flight, and every one is written (ledger P-323); the render thread answers at exit (P-322).

expect.no_log: the pictures asked were not all written at exit
the render thread held at exit
the renderer kept the surface past 2 s
